analysis: Frozen launcher --audit verified parent/worker closure, source/input integrity, all four trajectory replays, tool exposures and shared cost accounting before prospective scalar scoring.

scope.task_pair: Researcher-clarified 766 distinct names to 786 distinct hero IDs

scientific_readout.observed: All four model-generated queries were identical, counted distinct hero IDs with the reviewed Strength filter/global maximum, and produced the reference scalar. No cache was read, including when available and priced below SQL.
scientific_readout.supported: No availability/price contrast in first action or scalar correctness was observed in this single adapted development pair. Ordinary recomputation sufficed for this case.
not_supported: A general absence of cache-induced errors or demand reinterpretation
C-type demand drift or an inference about hidden internal intent
Method superiority over strong verification/recomputation baselines
Four independent task successes or a population accuracy estimate
Beneficial selective reuse, because this pair only tests an information-losing cache

decision.current_case: Retain as a negative finding; do not tune prices, prompts or seeds until an error appears.
decision.method_gate: No demonstrated remaining method gap on this case; do not name a new algorithm or claim necessity for contract-first intervention.
decision.next_smallest_useful_check: Before enlarging the study, assess whether the same symmetric ordinary-workflow interface supports legitimate cheap reuse on the already reviewed sufficient-information positive control. Keep contracts and information fair, freeze before any paid execution, and do not pool the older asymmetric positive-control run with this batch.
decision.interpretation_of_future_control: If both positive and negative cases always recompute, the interface/model may simply be insensitive to reuse incentives; that would not demonstrate selective applicability reasoning or C-type drift. If legitimate reuse occurs only on the positive control, it supports local selectivity, not a novel method.

publication_boundary: This receipt contains aggregate results only. Raw prompts, responses, private review records and database snapshots remain local and ignored by Git. Remote synchronization is not claimed; the prior user-side Git authentication blocker remains.
